answer: Sybil farms can be priced by correlated-error slashing: when k keys from one operator submit the same wrong answer, each loses k POA of stake, so the group forfeits k^2 POA, visible in the chain history. Two mirror keys lose 4, ten lose 100, a thousand lose 1,000,000, while one honest key erring alone loses just 1. Clone farms repeating one fable tumble into a canyon of losses that deepens with every added key. Weakness: operators can add random noise to hide the correlation.
